purpose: Full location hierarchy for every starmap entity in the game files - which star system it's in, and the nearest Planet/Moon it sits on (if any) - for use anywhere the site needs to break locations down below system level (missions, commodities, crafting, future ship-viewer POIs).
source: data-layer/derived/starmap-routes/entities.json (pre-existing, built by an earlier session from starmap.json + starmap_positions.json - reused here rather than rebuilt, since it already resolves 2,066 entities including asteroid-belt sub-locations that raw starmap.json's ParentUUID chain alone does not carry clean names for)
method: For every entity, walked parent_uuid up to one of the 3 true root Star-type nodes (Stanton, Pyro, Nyx - identified by Type.Name=='Star', not the 4 disconnected 'X System' placeholder nodes that share the name but are not the real parent chain) to resolve 'system'. Separately walked to the nearest ancestor of type Planet or Moon to resolve 'settlement'. ancestor_path shows the full chain for spot-checking.
no_settlement_reason: An entity with no settlement is not a gap - most are asteroid fields, jump points, or manmade stations that orbit the star directly rather than a planet or moon, which is how the game itself structures them.
known_gap: 12 entities (name prefix 'UGF_...', underground/bunker FPS locations) have parent_uuid null and do not resolve to any system through this hierarchy - they appear to be registered outside the main starmap parent chain. Left as system=null rather than guessed. See templates MANIFEST for where this matters (mission location joins).
note_on_landing_zones: Only 7 LandingZone entities total: New Babbage, Orison, Area18, Lorville (Stanton, the 4 established cities), plus Ghost Arena and Contested Zone x2 (Pyro - arena/contested-zone type locations, not full settled cities as of this snapshot's patch). This is a fact about the game's current content, not a resolution gap - Pyro does not yet have Stanton-style cities in 4.9.
related_but_not_folded_in: resources/trade_locations.json (965 rows) is a finer-grained registry of interior sub-zones (shop floors, security checkpoints, lobbies) inside outposts/stations - only 231/965 names match a gazetteer entity directly, because most are rooms inside a facility, not independently mappable starmap points. Left as a separate, not-yet-consumed dataset - relevant to a future interior/amenity feature, not to this location hierarchy.
